design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER - task 1 (preorders_and_backorders, Marlowe & Finch)

[0] Draw and scope snapshot. `draw_counts.py ... --task 1` printed {"task": 1, "key": "env_0031_online_fashion_retailer/preorders_and_backorders/1", "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [4, 5, 5, 4]}. Occupied by task 0: preorders_ext_made_to_order_work_charge and preorders_ext_made_to_order_remake_deposit with their two tools. Claimed here (disjoint): preorders_ext_price_protection (4 factors, lower_reserved_price_a108b215, agent, state_due), preorders_ext_preorder_cancellation_charge (5, confirm_preorder_cancellation_aa3f8734, user), preorders_ext_made_to_order_deposit (4, pay_reservation_deposit_93996964, user), preorders_ext_replacement_deposit (5, take_replacement_reservation_e3795f43, agent, root). Last task: after it every extended policy is claimed exactly once and no tool is spare. Consistency with task 0: the made-to-order deposit law claimed here is the law that fixed task 0's 151.20 deposit (Icon 30 percent less 2 points for footwear lines) - task 0's remake carries that paid percentage.

[1] Why this is a good test. Simone asks for one thing: her black designer coat pre-order in a large instead of a medium. To deliver it the agent must read the replacement policy's three prerequisite sentences, discover from the records that (a) the coat's reserved price (895.00) has not been lowered although her own order shows the style booked at 745.00 regular on 2026-09-22, (b) the coat is still reserved with 179.00 standing, and (c) her made-to-order loafer reserved last night has no deposit charged; resolve them in an order the sentences entail (price protection before the cancellation charge; all three before the replacement), handing two of them to the customer, and compute four multi-factor numbers on the handling-time world. Difficulty: reading policy, eight record families (reservations, histories, membership, ledger, orders, lines, payments, returns, Unlimited) and arithmetic; each policy names one tool.

[2] Problem-tree card. Root B = replacement deposit. Edges: B -> A (value_input, gate setoff_share, state form, affirmative: "A replacement is taken only after the reservation it replaces shows status cancelled with its deposit settled to nothing."); B -> P (value_input, gate price, state form, negated: "The deposit on a replacement is not worked out until the reservation it replaces carries its protected reserved price as its reserved unit price."); B -> C (state_gate, gate reservation_events.amount_usd, state form, negated: "A replacement is not taken until every Made-to-Order Reservation the customer holds in status reserved shows its deposit charged."); A -> P (value_input, gate price, state form, affirmative: "The cancellation charge is fixed only after the reserved unit price stands at the reservation's protected reserved price."). Scope of the two price sentences: they wait on exactly the result price protection defines - its 'protected reserved price' (the most recent qualifying booking for the member's tier, on or after the reservation date, limited by the protection limit, and the reserved price itself when nothing qualifies) - so they are neither broader nor narrower than that policy's write (round-1 finding CG-5 closed). Four-point test: ordering connective in each; record-visible states (status, deposit entries, the reserved unit price against the protected reserved price, a deposit-capture entry); no tool, id or code token; scope as stated. One write per state: only price protection sets a reserved price to its protected reserved price; only the customer's Deposit Pre-Order confirmation cancels a Deposit Pre-Order and books its charge and refund; only the customer's deposit payment books a capture on an existing made-to-order reservation that lacks one. Unresolved at frozen_time: coat status reserved and capture 179.0; coat unit_price_usd 895.0 against a protected reserved price below it (the 745.00 Camel booking of 2026-09-22, Platinum style tier); loafer deposit_required_usd empty and no capture. Order: P (step 9) -> A (13) -> C (16) -> B (18); C commutes with P and A (moving C ahead of P gives the identical terminal hash, run during authoring). Deletion sensitivity (actual runs): skip A -> B 84.67; skip P -> B 76.28 and A 64.44; skip C -> the loafer's deposit and capture are missing from the terminal state (state gate). user_scenario names none of them; each is a passive reaction.

[3] Base-invariant card. Price protection (subject preorders_price_lowered): preorders_evt_price_protection gate before_shipment ("A price is lowered only while the reservation is in status reserved, awaiting_consent, in_production or allocated.") holds - coat status reserved; overwrite replaces the lowest-SKU-price sentence (now evidenced by order-line bookings, with a protection limit) and the clearance/flash sentence (Icon/Atelier also clearance). Cancellation charge (preorders_cancelled, forfeited, refunded): preorders_evt_cancellation_refund; the full-refund-before-cutoff sentence and the booked-after-cancellation gate are replaced by declared overwrite; inherited: at-will cancellation before allocation (coat not allocated), any delay notice -> full refund (none here), refund to the original card. Made-to-order deposit (preorders_deposit_captured): preorders_evt_deposit (captured once, by card) - policy_scope; base deposit sentence replaced; payment_decline_grace_hours 48 from preorders_evt_authorization is the hold window (loafer reserved 2026-10-04 19:05, frozen 2026-10-05 15:10 = 20 hours). Replacement (preorders_reserved, captured): preorders_reservation, preorders_agg_multi_holding (2 open after: loafer + replacement <= 10), preorders_agg_launch_style_limit (n/a), preorders_evt_deposit - all policy_scope; base preorders_evt_size_change ("on a back-order or launch the customer must cancel and reserve again") is why a used size change leads to a replacement. No time gate is used by any gold write.

[4] Business-object card. Coat reservation (MF-462190-BLK-MD, 895.00, 179.00 captured, ship-by 2026-10-13, size change used): key reservation_id; its history (1 capture, no notice). Loafer reservation (MF-418977-TAN-75, 480.00, made-to-order, S.P., no deposit). Evidence rows: order line 2026-09-22 Camel M coat at 745.00 regular (qualifies: style match, regular, after 2026-07-15; the reserved SKU itself has no booking); 9 orders, 16 lines, 9 payments (24-month captured 3941.43, 12-month 3004.31); 3 return authorizations (2025-10-12 expired, 2026-03-25 and 2026-06-10 cancelled - none refunded anything); 6 earnings (5450 points in 12 months; the 2025-09-23 posting of 420 excluded); Unlimited Express Monthly active; Platinum enrolled 2020-02-11. The replacement copies style, colour, price, units and ship-by dates from the coat it replaces (replaced_reservation_id).

[5] Factor card (actual run, labels as corrected after the round-1 audit). P (baseline: latest regular booking of the reserved SKU itself, standard limit 0.05 -> 895.00 since none exists): qualifying_booking_selection (method: which booking set gives the price - for Icon/Atelier the latest of the regular and clearance bookings of the style, never a flash-sale one; for Gold/Platinum the latest regular booking of the style; otherwise the SKU's own; Platinum -> 745.00; baseline 895.00), protection_limit (parameter, loyalty; 0.10; baseline 814.45), waiting_addition (parameter, date; +0.03; baseline 796.55), unlimited_limit_addition (parameter, multi-source over two distinct records: an active Unlimited plan on the pass record AND an active Gold-or-above membership on the Marlowe Rewards record; +0.01; baseline 778.65) -> 769.70. A (baseline: price x 0.10, cap at deposit -> 76.97): ship_by_proximity_rate (parameter; 0.15; 36.95), restocking_waiver (parameter; one membership row, tier waiver and months; x0.50; 110.84), returns_adjustment (parameter; 3 return authorizations in 12 months -> x1.20; 46.18), points_count_method (method: which ledger entries count and by which date - Platinum/Icon/Atelier: earning and bonus entries by posting date, pending included; Gold/Silver: earning entries by posting date; otherwise earning entries by the date they became available; Platinum -> 5450; baseline 4080 -> x0.90 gives 62.35 - near-miss: the 1790 points posted 2026-09-24 are still pending), points_relief (parameter; x0.80; 69.27) -> 55.42, refund 123.58. C (baseline: 50 percent, floor 50 -> 240.00): made_to_order_rate (parameter; one membership row; 40; 220.80), spend_window (method; 24 months halved; 158.40), spend_reduction (2 points; 182.40), footwear_reduction (2 points; 182.40) -> 172.80. B (baseline: 20 percent of the carried price, floor 25 -> 153.94; the baseline paragraph no longer mentions a set-off, so the fall-back is one definite number): replacement_rate (parameter; 15; 93.29), waiting_factor (parameter: a coefficient on the percentage; x0.8; 85.59), charge_setoff (parameter; one condition, days since the replaced reservation's cancellation date; 0.40; 84.67), apparel_window (method: window convention - 24-month count halved for members of 60+ months, since the enrolment month for new members, otherwise 12 months; 9 / 2 = 4.5; baseline 12 months gives 6 lines -> 2 points, 54.80), apparel_points_off (parameter; 1 point; 70.20) -> 62.50. Every factor moves its result; every whole baseline is definite and differs from gold. Per computation: P 3P/1M, A 4P/1M, C 3P/1M, B 4P/1M.

[6] Seed rows (claims checked against the factor tiers). Customer (identity); membership + ledger (tier, tenure, waiver, points count - the pending 2026-09-24 entry moves the points relief between methods; the 2025-09-23 entry of 420 points is outside the posting-date window the Platinum counting uses but inside the available-date window (available 2025-10-23), so it is part of the 4080 the standard counting gives; removing it leaves 3660, the same tier); Unlimited (limit addition); 9 orders/16 lines/9 payments (the 745.00 Camel booking sets the protected price; footwear, apparel and spend counts); 3 returns (returns adjustment); coat reservation + capture (object of P, A, B); loafer reservation (object of C). Rows outside every window that any factor reads - the 2024-09-20 order with its payment and two lines, and the accessories scarf - are the history a real profile carries; removing any of them changes no tier and no scored value. Removing the 745.00 booking makes P a no-op; removing the loafer removes the state gate. No automatic clause fires: the coat's ship-by 2026-10-13 is in the future (no notice owed yet); the loafer's specification window runs to 2026-10-11 and its grace hours to 2026-10-06 19:05; neither is a Launch. The loafer's empty deposit_required_usd records that no deposit has been fixed since its card charge was declined (0.00 in the schema means a type without a deposit).

[7] Persona. Simone Pickering, warm and chatty; volunteers only the coat in a large and the fact (true in the record) that she already switched once from S to M; name + email to be found, mobile as second credential; size L, colour black; passive reactions: agrees to the cancellation and charge once explained and confirms it herself with the figures given, welcomes the price reduction, remembers the declined loafer charge only once told and pays it herself with the figures given, allows the card on file for the replacement deposit, accepts deposit and date, ends the call once told the large coat is reserved.

[8] Standard solution: find_customers -> verify (email, phone) -> find_reservations -> find_reservation_events -> find_loyalty_memberships -> find_orders -> find_order_lines -> find_pass_memberships -> lower_reserved_price(coat, protected reserved price) -> find_return_cases -> find_loyalty_ledger -> (customer) confirm_preorder_cancellation(coat, charge, refund of the rest) -> find_order_payments -> (customer) pay_reservation_deposit(loafer, deposit) -> take_replacement_reservation(coat, "L", replacement deposit). Values as in computations[].expected and in [5].

[9] Verification (repo root). Round 1: every per-task gate green. Round 2, after the audit rework, full block without --task: EXTENDED OK; TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; REPLAY OK (1.json 19 True True 0 49 49 True); SOLVABILITY OK; COMPUTE OK (1.json 4 computations, 18 factors); GROUNDING OK; SCOPE OK; CACHE-DIFF INFO. check_traceability not run: no published KB yet. Rework authoring run printed P 769.7, A 55.42 (refund 123.58), C 172.8, B 62.5; A without P 64.44; B without P 76.28; B without A 84.67.

[10] Closure. P -> lower_reserved_price -> computations[0] step 9 -> coat unit price 769.70; A -> confirm_preorder_cancellation -> computations[1] step 13 -> coat cancelled, charge kept and rest refunded; C -> pay_reservation_deposit -> computations[2] step 16 -> loafer deposit fixed + capture; B -> take_replacement_reservation -> computations[3] step 18 -> new Deposit Pre-Order MF-462190-BLK-LG, L, 769.70, ship-by 2026-10-13, deposit captured. Scope = the whole tree; required_documents in the same order; task_tools in first-call order.

[11] Easy mistakes. Comparing only the reserved SKU (no booking -> no protection) instead of the style; ignoring the protection limit (745.00); computing the charge on 895.00; counting points by available date (4080) for a Platinum member; forgetting the waiver or the returns adjustment; the 12-month spend or apparel window for a 79-month member; taking the replacement while the loafer stands uncharged; computing the replacement deposit before the cancellation (no charge to set off) or on 895.00.

[12] Draft recomputation from the visible context (hidden assets masked): the four policies' prose, the tool docstrings, the finder returns and the persona lead to the protected reserved price 769.70, a charge of 769.70 x 0.15 x 0.50 x 1.20 x 0.80 = 55.42 with the rest refunded, the loafer deposit 172.80 and a replacement deposit of 769.70 x 11 / 100 - 0.40 x 55.42 = 62.50 with size L - identical to gold.

[13] Rework round 2 (policy-task audit). CG-1: returns_look_back removed (returns now over a fixed 12 months) and replaced by points_count_method, a genuine method (which ledger entries count and by which date); waiting_factor relabelled parameter and the pass factor removed from the replacement; apparel_window added as the replacement's method (window convention). Counts stay on the draw [4, 5, 5, 4]. CG-2: the set-off ladder no longer restates the replacement's prerequisite (days since cancellation only), and the Unlimited addition of price protection now combines the pass record with the Marlowe Rewards record (genuine multi-source; Simone: Express Monthly + Platinum). CG-3: the replacement baseline drops 'less any charge set-off' and is a definite paragraph (153.94 here). CG-4: the Icon/Atelier branch of price protection now takes the most recent of the regular and clearance bookings of the style (a later flash-sale booking is ignored), matching the rule. CG-5: both price prerequisite sentences now wait on 'the protected reserved price', the term price protection's rule defines for its own result. O-8: the deposit gate names made-to-order reservations only. O-10: the protection limit is stated once (standard value `limit_standard`, per-tier values after). O-11: the cancellation-charge rule keeps the base full refund before the cutoff for every other type. O-5: the price tool docstring no longer says later charges are worked out on the lowered price. Findings 4-5 (false assertions in [2], [5], [6]) rewritten above. Scored values changed for A and B (computed on the corrected policies); P and C are unchanged. O-12 (a Deposit Pre-Order's kept charge is booked on the forfeiture event, whose base meaning names made-to-order items), O-13, O-15, O-16, O-19 (find_orders kept: the order rows are parents of the counted lines and must be in the read closure) and O-20 are recorded in the worklog.

[14] Rework round 3 (audit revision_2). R2-1: [6] placed the 2025-09-23 ledger entry 'outside every window'; it lies outside the posting-date window but inside the available-date window (available 2025-10-23) that the standard points counting uses, and it is part of the 4080 behind the points_count_method baseline figure. [6] now says so and the entry is no longer listed among rows outside every window. Charter observations O-21 and O-22 closed (see worklog). O-23 (pts_available_earned listed under points_relief) is kept: the gates require each factor to own a record read, and that read is the standard count the relief falls back to. No scored value changed.
user_scenario: You are Simone Pickering, a marketing manager in Chicago, friendly and talkative, calling Marlowe & Finch on your lunch break. Back in July you reserved the Ravel Atelier Double-Faced Wool Coat in black as a designer pre-order and paid a deposit; in August you already switched it once, from a small to a medium. Since then you tried the same coat on at a friend's and you are now certain the medium will be tight over sweaters, so what you want is the black coat in a large instead, sorted out today, and you would like the agent to do it for you. You open by explaining that you have the black Ravel Atelier coat on pre-order in a medium and need it in a large. To find your account you give your name and the email you sign in with, simone.pickering@icloud.com; if they need a second detail you give your mobile number, 3125550171, and only if that is still not enough your date of birth, 1991-09-23, or your billing ZIP code, 60614. You do not know any reservation or order numbers and happily let the agent look things up. If asked, the size you want is L, the colour stays black, and you want nothing else about the coat to change. If the agent explains that because you already used your one size change the medium has to be cancelled and the coat reserved again in the new size, and that part of the deposit is kept as a cancellation charge, you say that is a shame but fine, and agree. If the agent tells you the coat's price has come down and they will lower your reserved price, you are delighted and say yes. When the agent tells you that you have to confirm the cancellation yourself and hands you the step to do it, you confirm the cancellation yourself straight away using exactly the reservation and amounts the agent gives you, and read back what it shows. If the agent tells you that the deposit on another reservation of yours did not go through, you remember that the custom penny loafers you ordered last night were declined because your bank had just sent you a new card; you say you will pay that deposit yourself with the new card, and when the agent hands you the step you pay the deposit yourself using exactly the reservation and amount the agent gives you, and read back what it shows. If the agent asks whether they may charge the deposit for the large coat to the card on your account, you say yes, the new card is on the account now. When the agent tells you the new coat's deposit and its ship-by date, you accept them. Once the agent tells you the large coat is reserved, you thank them warmly and end the call.

gold_actions.business_effect: The coat's reserved unit price is lowered under price protection.

request_binding.action_semantics: Price protection is owed by the state of the records whenever a qualifying lower booking of the reserved style stands after the reservation date; it is a system obligation the charge and the replacement wait on, not a caller request.

base_preconditions.condition: A price is lowered only while the reservation is in status reserved, awaiting_consent, in_production or allocated.

request_binding.action_semantics: A Deposit Pre-Order whose one size change is used is swapped by cancelling and reserving again; the at-will cancellation keeps a charge, and confirming a cancellation that forfeits deposit is the customer's own act, so her agreed confirmation selects this action.

user_scenario:you confirm the cancellation yourself straight away

seed_consistency.check: Deposit Pre-Order reserved 2026-07-15 for 895.00 x 1; deposit 179.00 = 20 percent (deposit_pct) at reservation, above deposit_min_usd 25.00; ship-by 2026-10-13 = reservation + 90 days (max_initial_ship_by_days 90); one size change used (S to M) of max_size_changes 1; status reserved, not allocated; no delay notice.

Made-to-Order Reservation reserved 2026-10-04 19:05 (20 hours before frozen_time, within payment_decline_grace_hours 48), 480.00 x 1, personalisation S.P. recorded, specifications not yet confirmed (window open to 2026-10-11), ship-by 2026-11-29 = reservation + 56; its deposit charge was declined, so no deposit is fixed and no capture stands. Its empty deposit_required_usd is the decline record: no deposit has been fixed yet (the schema's 0.00 is reserved for types that take no deposit).
The coat deposit captured once at reservation 2026-07-15 by card, equal to deposit_required_usd 179.00.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's profile by name and sign-in email.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write is keyed by the customer reference number.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.reservation_id: d0080f4d-0b1d-4735-982c-866779a4a5b5. Basis: the reservation lookup returns the customer's Deposit Pre-Order of the 'Ravel Atelier Double-Faced Wool Coat' (black, M, status reserved), the coat the customer calls about ('the black Ravel Atelier coat on pre-order in a medium'). Uniqueness: her only coat reservation; the other reservation is a made-to-order loafer, which keeps its reserved price.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.new_unit_price_usd: 769.70. Reserved 895.00. Qualifying bookings: active Marlowe Rewards Platinum enrolled 2020-02-11 (79 months >= 24) -> the most recent regular-price booking of the style in any colour or size: 'Ravel Atelier Double-Faced Wool Coat', Camel, M, booked 2026-09-22 at 745.00 (on/after the reservation date 2026-07-15); the reserved SKU MF-462190-BLK-MD itself has no booking. Limit 0.10 (Platinum) + 0.03 (held 82 days >= 60) + 0.01 (Unlimited Express Monthly, active, held by an active Platinum member) = 0.14 -> floor 895 x 0.86 = 769.70; the higher of 745.00 and 769.70 = 769.70, below 895.00 -> 769.70.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the return authorizations with their opened dates.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The count opened in the last 12 months sets the returns adjustment of the charge.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: For a Platinum member the points relief counts earning and bonus entries by posting date over 12 months, pending points included.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.reservation_id: d0080f4d-0b1d-4735-982c-866779a4a5b5. Basis: the A rule applies to 'an unallocated Deposit Pre-Order' the customer cancels; the replacement rule names the reservation it replaces. Uniqueness: the black M coat reservation (status reserved, not allocated).
argument_uniqueness_tracing.cancellation_charge_usd: 55.42. Price 769.70 x 1 (the protected reserved price set at step 9); 8 days from 2026-10-05 to the ship-by date in force 2026-10-13 -> rate 0.15; Platinum carries the restocking-fee waiver and is enrolled 79 months >= 60 -> x0.50; 3 return authorizations opened in the last 12 months -> x1.20; points counted for a Platinum member: earning and bonus entries by posting date in 12 months = 5450 (the 420 posted 2025-09-23 is older) -> x0.80; no delay notice. 769.70 x 0.15 x 0.50 x 1.20 x 0.80 = 55.4184, below the 179.00 held -> 55.42.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.deposit_refund_usd: 123.58. 'the refund of the rest is the deposit held less the charge': 179.00 - 55.42 = 123.58.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The loafer payment writes only the loafer reservation and its history; price protection and the cancellation write only the coat. Replaying gold with the payment moved ahead of price protection gives the same terminal hash (f2c6d0134d6c455b... both orders, run during authoring) and the same four scored values. Price protection must precede the cancellation (the charge's prerequisite sentence) and all three precede the replacement.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the cancellation no charge is kept, so the replacement deposit recomputes to 84.67 instead of the gold value, and the coat stays reserved with its deposit standing.
Without price protection (charge kept as in gold) the replacement deposit recomputes to 76.28 instead of the gold value, and the replacement carries 895.00.

Without the loafer payment the terminal state lacks its fixed deposit and its capture entry, and the replacement is taken while a made-to-order reservation stands uncharged (state gate); the replacement value itself is unchanged.
Without price protection the cancellation charge recomputes to 64.44 instead of the gold value.
